LESSON: GROWING FRUITS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Growing Fruits

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Growing Fruits
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we grow fruits?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify fruits that can grow the locality

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Growing Fruits

Teach
• Observe Growing Fruits in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Growing Fruits (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Growing Fruits.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Growing Fruits.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Growing Fruits.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify fruits that can grow the locality

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Growing Fruits.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Growing Fruits: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we grow fruits?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify fruits that can grow the locality

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
